Health.StabilizationStops: Stabilization stops Death's Door drain. Wound severity stays 3; Incapacitation remains.
Health.UnstabilizedLose: Unstabilized: lose 1 Endurance AND 1 Hope each combat round, or each hour outside combat. If already Exhausted, Endurance loss becomes another Hope loss (total −2 Hope). Apply manually; no timed drain is automated.
Health.IncapacitatedUntil: Incapacitated until no longer Despondent or no longer Exhausted
Health.BrokenCausesNo: Broken itself causes no Death's Door drain
Health.LosePower: Lose 1 Power at each combat round's end (minimum 0)
Health.ContinuouslyBroken: Continuously Broken for Body days causes death
Health.ApplyRulesManually: Apply these rules manually; no timer, drain or duration death is automated
Health.ReducingWounds: Reducing Wounds or changing resources does not clear recorded death.
Health.CorrectRecordedDeath: Correct the recorded death flag for bookkeeping/testing only
Health.NotHealingOrResurrection: This is not healing or resurrection
Health.LowerSeverityBeforeClearing: lower severity separately before clearing a mistaken death record

Mobile.LoadHint: From owned weapons, armor, and equipment
Mobile.PhysicalDice: Dice are rolled physically at the table.
Mobile.ActionHint: Enabled Item Actions. Values below include configured Action and current character-state modifiers. Stance and other situational restrictions are checked at the table.
Mobile.DamageHint: Physical Successes × Damage, then final modifiers (minimum 0).
Mobile.AddActionHint: Open an Item from Items and add an Action. Enable it to show it here.
Mobile.ItemsHint: Tap an Item to read or configure its Actions.
Mobile.NoItems: No owned Items yet. Ask the GM to add your equipment and features.

Item.ActionHint: Leave unknown rules values blank. Only enabled Actions appear on the character.
Item.ProficiencyPrecedence: takes precedence over this Action Skill.
Item.ThresholdHint: Universal base. Configure deviations as Threshold modifiers.
Item.ProficiencyHint: Stable proficiency key used to look up the character's proficiency level.

Planner.FrozenHint: Declared values are frozen. Check off entries as you resolve them at the table.
Planner.PickerHint: Owned, enabled Actions. Incomplete or disallowed choices are flagged in the sequence.
Planner.NoActions: No enabled Actions. Configure your owned Items first.
Planner.PowerAlreadyDeclared: A Power Action is already declared; Main and additional Power Actions are unavailable.
Planner.MainAlreadyDeclared: Main Actions are already declared; Power Actions are unavailable.
Planner.Dead: This Fated is Dead and cannot lock a Turn Declaration.
Planner.Incapacitated: This Fated is Incapacitated ({conditions}) and cannot lock a normal Turn Declaration.
Planner.StanceRequired: Choose a stance before declaring Actions.
Planner.MainLimit: Declare no more than 3 Main Actions.
Planner.MovementLimit: Declare only one continuous Movement segment.
Planner.PowerExclusive: A Power Action must be the only Main/Power Action this turn.
Planner.EntryIds: Declaration entry IDs must be unique.
Planner.MissingAction: Source Action is no longer owned and enabled. Remove or replace this entry.
Planner.RollUnknown: {name}: set Requires Roll or No Roll on the Item Action.
Planner.RollIncomplete: {name}: complete Success Dice and modifier values before locking.
Planner.EndBeforeEditing: End this declaration before editing the next turn.
Planner.Permission: Only an owner of a Fated Actor can change its declaration.
Planner.Stale: This declaration changed. Review the refreshed turn and try again.
Planner.ActionUnavailable: Action is no longer owned and enabled.

Rest.ShortHint: Recover +1 Endurance. Optionally spend exactly 1 Hope for additional recovery. Enter a physical Healing result to Bandage Light or Grievous wounds.
Rest.LongHint: Recover Body Endurance and +1 Hope, capped at their limits. Reset Power to 0. Optional physical Healing heals Light wounds or treats Grievous wounds.
Rest.ExtendedHint: An Extended Rest lasts at least 24 fictional hours. Invoke each operation explicitly; none advances time or triggers another operation.
Rest.BeginHint: Beginning resets Power immediately, leaving Endurance and Hope unchanged.
Rest.DayHint: Each completed day fills Endurance and adds +1 Hope. Light heals automatically; optional physical Healing schedules Grievous healing for 24 hours later.
Rest.CareDayHint: When one fictional day has passed, advance wound-care duration separately. This gives no rest recovery and does not heal.
Rest.PendingHint: Pending Grievous healing needs 0 days remaining before explicit completion.

Damage.InputHint: Enter physical roll results. Preview changes no Actor data.
Damage.ManualHint: Manual Damage is already final; no attacker stance adjustment is added.
Damage.PreviewChanged: Inputs or Actor state changed. Review the updated preview and press Apply Wounds again.
Damage.Applied: Applied {wounds} Wounds in one update. Current severity: {severity}.

Companion.Hint: Use the Companion menu to refresh or log out. This screen updates when the GM changes your linked character.
Companion.Error: Companion Mode could not open. Use Refresh / reconnect in the Companion menu.
Companion.NoCharacter: No Fated character is assigned to your User. Ask the GM to assign your character in Foundry's User configuration.
Companion.WrongType: Your assigned character ({name}) is not a Fated Actor. Companion Mode supports Fated characters only.
Companion.NoPermission: Your assigned Fated character is unavailable. Ask the GM to check your Actor permissions.

Validation.TargetPermission: You cannot update this target Actor.

Validation.MultipleArmor: More than one Armor Item is Worn. Unwear the extra Armor before calculating Defense.
Validation.DefenseModifier: Defense modifiers require a label and source.
Validation.WoundsInteger: Wounds must be a nonnegative whole number.

Validation.SuccessesInteger: Physical Successes must be a whole number.
Validation.DamageModifiers: Final-damage modifiers require a value, label and source.
Validation.AttackUnavailable: The selected attack is no longer available. Preview again.
Validation.RangeOrder: Minimum range cannot exceed maximum range.
Validation.DeathCorrection: Only a GM can administratively correct the recorded death state.
Validation.ActionIds: Action IDs must be unique within an Item.
